reason: Candidate model passed all 8 automated performance, quality, and segment guardrails.

gates_evaluated.description: Candidate aggregate WAPE must not exceed the operational threshold ceiling
gates_evaluated.justification: Ensures inventory forecasting error does not create runaway replenishment deviations.

gates_evaluated.description: Candidate must outperform naive seasonal Lag-7 baseline by defined minimum relative lift
gates_evaluated.justification: Machine learning model must convincingly justify deployment overhead over simple retail heuristics.

gates_evaluated.description: Candidate R-squared must indicate meaningful signal capture over mean prediction
gates_evaluated.justification: Protects against models that perform no better than constant horizontal projections.

gates_evaluated.description: Fast-moving revenue drivers must maintain tight WAPE guardrails
gates_evaluated.justification: Fast movers generate over 50% of volume; excessive error here severely damages cash flow.

gates_evaluated.description: Mid-velocity SKUs must adhere to bounded variance guardrail
gates_evaluated.justification: Maintains catalog consistency without permitting mid-tier margin erosion.

gates_evaluated.description: Slow-moving intermittent SKUs must not exceed volatility tolerance threshold
gates_evaluated.justification: Accounts for zero-sales days while preventing extreme over-forecasting.

gates_evaluated.description: Training and inference datasets must pass automated integrity and quality checks
gates_evaluated.justification: Corrupted or duplicate transactional data must never propagate into active models.

gates_evaluated.description: 80% nominal prediction intervals must demonstrate verified empirical coverage
gates_evaluated.justification: Safety stock formulas rely directly on calibrated uncertainty bounds.

rollback_target.description: Pre-promotion snapshot for fast single-command rollback.
